newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Bangladesh taka ends flat in dull market.
newsitem.headline: Bangladesh taka ends flat in dull market.

text.p: The Bangladesh taka closed flat at 42.5440/5460 to the dollar in interbank trading on Sunday, amid continued year-end supply of the U.S. currency, dealers said.
The local unit was quoted in a wide range at 42.5430/5480 to the dollar in early trade.
"Dollar demand was dull with most banks remaining busy in squaring their positions ahead of the New Year. Even the smaller banks are now offering dollars in the market," said one dealer.
The call money was traded at 5.0 to 6.0 percent, up from Saturday's 3.5-5.0 percent.
